verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.sentry.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200). The docs serve markdown versions of pages (e.g. /ai/agent-plugin.md, /product/agents.md, /cli/*.md), and Sentry ships agent-oriented material: a one-command agent setup for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok, dotagents skills, and an MCP server that can read documentation. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents actually work well when fed these docs.
